name: Dawnwalker Controller Tweaks
summary: Configure controller bindings with an INI, swap shoulders and triggers, enjoy a wider walking range, and use short press Map / long press Game Hub. Requires UE4SS.
thumbnailAltText: Controller Tweaks title over an official in-game screenshot of Coen walking through a town market.
requiredMods: Dawnwalker-compatible UE4SS with TMap and LoopInGameThreadWithDelay
fileDescription: Configure all 31 bindings with a documented personal INI preserved across updates. Requires UE4SS. Replace/reinstall through Vortex as Root (game folder). Includes shoulder/trigger, walking and Map/Hub tweaks. INI remapping: in-game testing pending.

optionalFiles.name: Original Shoulder Buttons
optionalFiles.description: Original LB/LT and RB/RT, including Photo Mode. Requires main 1.4.0 + UE4SS. MANUAL ONLY: back up your personal INI, then copy/merge using README. Replacement overwrites preferences. Do not install via Vortex. In-game testing pending.
